result.title: Normalize deployment.environment and expand accepted values
result.author: mira

pr.title: Normalize deployment.environment and expand accepted values
pr.author: mira
pr.description: Simplify the production deployment.environment parser and permit additional deployment naming.

diff_summary.production_parser: Lowercase every supplied value and publish the resulting string without an allowlist check.
diff_summary.missing_input: Publish deployment.environment=unknown when the input is absent.
diff_summary.downstream_validation: No rollup-service parity fixture or producer-consumer compatibility evidence is included.

args.body: Request changes. Production deployment.environment must accept only case-insensitive exact values prod, staging, and dev, publishing the canonical lowercase value. Missing input must omit the key/label; it must not publish unknown. Reject qa, unknown, whitespace-padded, malformed, and arbitrary values before metric publication—lowercasing alone is not validation. The per-tenant distinct-value ceiling is 3 and must be enforced before admitting a series, so a fourth value can never be published. Add executable bidirectional parity evidence across the full metrics path: the producer mapping and OTel ingestion output, metrics-router output, and rollup-service consumer must have matching key presence and bounded values; fail on missing expected keys or unexpected downstream values. Include rejected-input/no-series and tenant-budget regression coverage before sign-off.
